 Calls for minimum wage freeze to increase youth employment 
 Prosperity Institute report urges five-year freeze on National Living Wage to boost youth hiring 
 Regulations & Policies 
 Olivia Watts Just now 2 min read 
 The UK government has been urged to freeze the minimum wage at £12.71 an hour for five years, arguing that rising wage costs are restricting employment opportunities for young people and increasing pressure on businesses.
